snippet.title: What Happens If Ronaldo Never Retires in FC 26?
snippet.description:
In this EA FC 26 experiment, I wanted to find out just how old a player can actually get in Career Mode.

So I started with Cristiano Ronaldo at 41 years old, gave him a long contract, and kept renewing it season after season to see how far the game would let him go.

As the years passed, his overall and attributes kept dropping until things started getting ridiculous. By 75 years old, he was down to just 25 overall with only 9 pace… but I still wasn’t done.

I kept simulating all the way toward 100 years old to see what would happen, how low his rating could go, and whether EA FC 26 would eventually force him to retire.

This is just an in-game experiment made for entertainment purposes. Obviously, none of this is meant to represent Cristiano Ronaldo’s real career or abilities.

If you enjoy EA FC experiments, weird Career Mode situations, mods and things you probably weren’t supposed to do in the game, subscribe for more.
